annotations.title: Set or remove a server's resource pack

description: Sets the resource pack players are offered on join, from Modrinth, an uploaded .zip or a link; from: none removes it. It applies at the next restart (restartToApplySettings). Make it mandatory with resourcePackRequired in updateServer. Returns the server.

from.description: modrinth: a Modrinth project; upload: a .zip from startAssetUpload; link: a direct https link; none: remove the pack.

projectId.description: Modrinth project id, not the slug.

from.description: modrinth: a Modrinth project; upload: a .zip from startAssetUpload; link: a direct https link; none: remove the pack.

key.description: key from startAssetUpload, after inspectAssetUpload has completed the upload. The upload is used up on success.

from.description: modrinth: a Modrinth project; upload: a .zip from startAssetUpload; link: a direct https link; none: remove the pack.

url.description: Direct https link to the .zip; it is downloaded and checked now.

from.description: modrinth: a Modrinth project; upload: a .zip from startAssetUpload; link: a direct https link; none: remove the pack.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.
